parsed.note_markdown:
### HBAN — Stable reported EPS, softer adjusted earnings

**Reported GAAP diluted EPS was unchanged sequentially at $0.33**, while adjusted EPS declined from $0.39 to $0.38 after excluding acquisition-related and other notable impacts. Net income available to common shareholders was $680 million versus $686 million in 2Q26 [B0031, B0063–B0069, B0028].

**EPS drivers:** Acquisition-related expenses had a negative $0.05 per-share impact. Underlying fee income declined while spread income improved, and adjusted expenses were nearly unchanged [B0063, B0166, B0225].

**Revenue and margin:** GAAP NII grew $17 million to $2,069 million. FTE NIM expanded 4 basis points to 3.25%. Noninterest income declined $63 million to $722 million, while reported expenses fell $37 million to $1,772 million [B0022, B0037, B0024, B0027].

**Credit:** Provision decreased to $123 million from $132 million. Net charge-offs increased to $146 million, producing a 0.31% annualized charge-off ratio. ACL coverage was 1.75% [B0251–B0253, B0429].

**Capital and returns:** CET1 reached 10.1%, with reported ROTCE of 14.6% and adjusted ROTCE of 16.6%. Tangible book value was $9.47 per share, and share repurchases totaled $100 million [B0040, B0035, B0036, B0032, B0019].

**Guidance:** Management expressed confidence in achieving financial targets and acquisition synergies without providing a new quantified revision in the identified release commentary [B0050].

**Investment thesis:** Broadly unchanged. Margin expansion and integration synergies provide support, but adjusted EPS declined and charge-offs increased.
